annotations.title: Rent points estimate for a Dutch home (paid)

description: Netherlands rent check (huurcheck, huurpunten berekenen, WWS) for one address: estimated points range from BAG floor area, energy label and neighbourhood WOZ, the likely rent segment (social up to 143 points, middle 144-186, free sector 187+) and the approximate maximum basic rent (2026 limits). An estimate, with a link to the official Huurcommissie check. For tenant, relocation and housing agents. Input: postcode + house number. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402, or 5 credits of a Factline API key.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
